An '''instructor''' was an individual responsible for conducting the training of another, or a group. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] employed instructors to train their new recruits and sharpen the skills of veteran [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Several instructors were deployed to [[Oracle Base]], including the head [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Gar Berra]].
